items.text: Green Bay is without DTs Javon Hargrave and Jonathan Ford and WR Skyy Moore; DT Jordon Riley is doubtful. RB Josh Jacobs is not eligible until Week 7.
Dallas is without CB Cobie Durant and OT Drew Shelton; CB Joey Porter Jr. is questionable but the team expects him to play.
Saturday: Dallas downgraded LB DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring) to out; he has missed every game since Week 1. Jaishawn Barham and Dee Winters continue at LB.

adjust.reason: Green Bay is down two starting DTs with a third doubtful; Dallas loses a CB and a tackle. Net edge to Dallas. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
